subject: math
description: Translate bearing descriptions into clear diagrams and use oblique-triangle information to plan navigation solutions.
learningObjectives: Interpret bearings as clockwise angles measured from north
Translate bearing descriptions into labeled diagrams
Identify the triangle formed by two travel paths and the distance between endpoints
Use direction information to determine included angles in navigation diagrams
Choose an appropriate oblique-triangle strategy after drawing the diagram
prerequisites: Basic triangle parts: sides, angles, vertices
Recognizing SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and SSA cases
